findings.title: ERV duct start points do not sit on the Broan B210E75RT's four real top ports

evidence.measured: Case x 68.04-92.84, y 347.5-368.5 (centre-positioned). Authored port points in unit frame (u from W edge, v from S edge): supply (15.96,18.5), return (17.96,2.5), OA (5.96,3.5), EA (5.96,15.5). OA and EA 12" apart in one column; supply/return 16" apart. Broan drawing: ports 1/2 (top row) centres 4-5/16" and 4-3/16" from opposite case sides (~13.4" apart) at 5-5/8" and 3-7/8" from rear; ports 4/3 (bottom row) 6-1/16" from each side (~9.75" apart) both 13-3/4" from rear; case is 21-7/8" wide plus a ~3" electrical box (24-13/16" overall), collars Ø6. For either handedness the model points land 5-16" from the real collars (e.g. return vs port 1, EA vs port 3 about 15").
evidence.expected: Collars on the delivered unit; every start point within ~1/2" of a real port
evidence.method: Broan spec PDF page 2 (6" Ports Dimensions) vs /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-colincatlin-Documents-NoCloud-TypeHaus/a9292deb-6aa8-41a7-a63e-497e3c7970b9/scratchpad/geometry-review/M1/model.pkl ducts[tag].path[0] minus EQ-B-ERV centre +-(12.4,10.5)"; probe inline in report. Handedness (box west/east, door south) is not encoded in the model (Equipment.rotation=None), so confidence is 0.5.

findings.source: https://broan-nutone.com/getmedia/a131be08-4510-4a59-ab11-026e99737f2e/Spec_Sheet_V210E75RT_En_Fr.pdf (V210 = Canadian twin of B210E75RT, same drawing); notes/erv_service_access.md cites the B210 sheet
findings.proposed_fix: Author the port pattern from the Broan drawing on EQ-T-BROAN-B210E75RT.ports with a rotation, pick box side west (east face is 0.06" from EQ-B-WH), and re-start the four trunk/hood legs on the real collars (reducers to 8" above the case). Routing re-proposal is out of scope here.

findings.title: Round ducts are labelled as rectangular W x D on every HVAC plan (4x4, 6x6, 8x8)

evidence.measured: Plans print '4x4 SUPPLY', '6x6 RETURN', '8x8 OUTDOOR_AIR', '8x8 EXHAUST'; M-103's note says 'Duct labels indicate width x depth'. ResolvedDuct stores diameter_m with width_m=depth_m=diameter for rounds. The only true rectangular ducts (18x8, 10x18, 10x8, 10x6) read the same way as the rounds.
evidence.expected: '4in dia' / '6in dia' / '8in dia (2in wrap, 12in OD)' for rounds; W x D only for rectangular
evidence.method: Read M-101..M-104 (permit_set.pdf pp 59-62); ducts diameter_m not None in model.pkl

findings.proposed_fix: Label by diameter when ResolvedDuct.diameter_m is set; print the 12" wrapped OD of OA/EA on the label or a note.

findings.title: Round-duct vertices are zero-radius mitres: many legs are shorter than the two elbow take-offs the catalog's own 1.5 D elbow needs

evidence.measured: Library says gored elbow centreline radius 1.5 D (take-off R*tan(theta/2) = 1.5 D per 90). 50 inter-vertex legs in 28 round runs are shorter than the sum of the take-offs at their ends; at 1.0 D still 39, at 0.75 D (tight stamped snap-lock) still 29. Hard cases that no elbow can make: DU-ERV-RISER-EXH leg 4 = 1.56" between two 90s (6"); DU-ERV-EA leg 4 = 2.9" between two 90s and leg 0 = 2.9" off the ERV collar (8", 12" OD wrapped; needs >=6" even at 0.75 D); DU-ERV-OA leg 6 = 2.9"; DU-B-ERV-R-SAUNA-EXH leg 6 = 2.0"; DU-B-ERV-RET-TRUNK leg 1 = 8" between two 6" 90s. The 4.87" jogs (111.63 -> 116.5) in FS-S-WEST on 9 radials only work with stamped elbows <=~0.75 D.
evidence.expected: Each leg >= sum of fitting take-offs for the stocked fitting (stamped adjustable 4"/6" elbow, gored or stamped 8"), or an offset fitting drawn
evidence.method: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-colincatlin-Documents-NoCloud-TypeHaus/a9292deb-6aa8-41a7-a63e-497e3c7970b9/scratchpad/geometry-review/M1/elbows.py (R=1.5D; edit factor for 1.0/0.75): per duct, clean 3-D vertices, t=R*tan(deflection/2), flag leg length < t_i+t_{i+1}. The pressure budget (erv_static_budget.md:98) assumes r/D=1.5 elbows (C=0.22) while the geometry cannot hold one.

findings.source: library/fittings.py SMACNA gored elbow R=1.5 D; Snappy/Hart & Cooley stamped adjustable elbow catalogue radii not published online (could not source)
findings.proposed_fix: Grade leg length against take-off in mep.fitting_pattern (it names patterns but never checks laying length), and either lengthen the worst legs or author the offset/step fitting; re-derive static budget with stamped-elbow K if stamped parts are what is bought.

findings.title: Wrapped (12 in OD) OA/EA first legs overlap the ERV case top by ~1 in and touch each other

evidence.measured: ERV case: bottom -109.44+54 = -55.44, body top (19.5" case, drawing) -35.94; collars to -33.75. OA first horizontal leg z centre -30.94 (OA wrap ring r 6 -> bottom -36.94) runs from x=74 to x=40 over case x 68-74..80: wrap bottom 1.0 in below the case top. OA (y=351) and EA (y=363) wraps are centred exactly 12.0 in apart, so the two 12 in OD wraps touch; the 2.9 in stub above the collar cannot hold the 6x8 increaser plus elbow.
evidence.expected: >=0 in clear of the case body, a reducer and elbow stack above the collars
evidence.method: Wrap sweep path from model.pkl solids 'DU-ERV-OA-WRAP'; case dims from Broan page 2; z values from ducts[].z_m.

findings.source: Broan spec drawing (case 19-1/2 in, 21-11/16 in with collars); AP Armaflex 2x1 in per air_distribution_products.md §9
findings.proposed_fix: Raise both legs' first horizontal run so wrap bottoms clear the case top (max headroom to joist soffit -11.88 is ~22 in) or drop wrap on the first 12 in; see M1-001.

findings.title: Floor-extract grille face is estimated 4 x 11 3/4 in; Reggio 412 scroll series publishes 3 1/2 x 12 in

evidence.measured: Type footprint (11.75, 4) 'estimated'; Reggio listing for 412-H/412-ANH sibling shows outside length 12, outside width 3-1/2 (412-AH's own page shows none). Boot 2 1/4x10x4 height 5 in also unpublished (Ferguson sells 10x2-1/4x5 for 5 in collar; P13-206 is 2-1/4x10x6 round, so 4 in collar boot likely ~5 in).
evidence.expected: face 12 x 3 1/2 in (flange), boot height from submittal
evidence.method: WebSearch 'Reggio 412-AH' (Amazon/Walmart listings) and 'Snappy P13-204'; compared with air_terminal_types.py

findings.proposed_fix: Set footprint to 12 x 3.5 and keep the 5 in boot as an estimate; confirm with the boot submittal.

findings.proposed_fix: Update the CLAUDE.md figures (or drop them; the guide itself says never author a clear width).

findings.title: Or-equal hood Fantech FML8 is a 9x9 plate; the OA/EA rough openings are 9x9 in

evidence.measured: FML8 spec table A=8, B=9, C=9, D=5 (duct 8, plate 9 x 9?, projection 5), so the or-equal plate does not lap a 9x9 hole; the basis RenewAire FA8-P plate size is unpublished (hoods PDF gives no dimensions). Model keeps a 12x12x12 envelope. Plate laps are a trim/sealing item at the cladding RO.
evidence.expected: plate laps the RO by >=3/4 in each side
evidence.method: WebSearch FML8 (fantech spec pdf d3nq8rpsskbdh6.cloudfront.net fml8_specs.pdf; eComfort 9x9x5); RenewAire Hoods-Dampers PDF read in full: no FA8 dims

findings.proposed_fix: Record on the submittal that the or-equal must have a plate >= 11 in, or trim the RO to the hood.

findings.title: DU-B-ERV-R-GYM carries 18.2 and 95.3 degree turns no stock 4 in elbow makes

evidence.measured: mep.fitting_pattern UNKNOWN: vertex 4 (18.2 deg), vertex 7 (95.3 deg); legs there are 6.12 in (needs 12.6 at 1.5 D) between a 95 and a 90 deg turn.
evidence.expected: 30/45/90 stock turns or a fabricated offset

findings.proposed_fix: Square the 95.3 deg turn to 90 and replace the 18.2 deg kink with a 15 deg-free offset or a 30 deg fitting.
